specificOwnershipNotes.comparison: Canonical 308 become a voice and 994 find their voice address different subject/agency constructions; this lesson targets a work expressing shared feelings.

Canonical 336 bring something into the public eye teaches a causative change, whereas this lesson uses the continuing state in the public eye. Canonical 116 in the spotlight is a close synonym for public visibility despite different lexemes/detectors; do not invent a duration or intensity boundary. Human owner sign-off and a cross-reference remain required.
Canonical 116 in the spotlight denotes current prominence; this lesson teaches a gradual move away from prominence over time.

deferredSourceOwnerQuestion.sourceSentence: The support team works around the clock.
deferredSourceOwnerQuestion.comparison: Both involve day-and-night coverage, but canonical 1343 is an attributive adjective plus supervision and asks learners to verify continuous oversight without assigning one person an unbroken shift. Source 2736 is an adverbial time phrase modifying works and could apply to support, production or transport. A separate seven-step lesson appears feasible around adverbial placement, shift-based coverage versus one worker without rest, continuous operation versus office hours, and measured claims about actual coverage. Keep its existing editorial decision unchanged pending explicit owner-scope review; do not auto-alias or draft in this batch.

remainingGates: Independent AI review, human English and Traditional Chinese editorial approval, audio generation and listening QA, device QA, and separate release authorization. No selection manifest or live files were modified.
